subject: SET statement (effect of SET on program whose address is being stored in a program-pointer)
notes: kb/Work PB460 - "SET statement (effect of SET on program whose address is being stored in a program-pointer). This item is required. This item shall be documented in the implementor's user documentation." (cite.py --check A.1 -> OK 175)). DETERMINATION: NONE - a SET stores the externalized program-name of an outermost program (8.4.3.13.4 GR2) in the managed ProgramPointer; it neither activates, loads (beyond the sibling-module probe a CALL would make), cancels nor re-initializes the program. Documented in docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 7 beside item 174 (the function twin, same answer).
